entries.en: He placed a hand over his anticardium when the carriage lurched.
entries.zh: 马车颠簸时，他把一只手放在了上腹部。

entries.en: Her thesis compared the evidence supporting the two products' anticarious claims.
entries.zh: 她的论文比较了支持那两款产品抗龋宣称的证据。

entries.en: The second fraction contained anticatalase, but the report did not explain how it was identified.
entries.zh: 第二份分离组分中含有抗过氧化氢酶，但报告没有解释它是如何被鉴定出来的。

entries.en: The old advertisement promised an anticatarrhal effect without describing any comparison with untreated symptoms.
entries.zh: 那则旧广告承诺具有抗卡他效果，却没有描述与未经处理症状的任何比较。

entries.en: The historian compared the advertised benefits of anticatarrhals with the symptoms described in patients' letters.
entries.zh: 历史学家把抗卡他类消炎药所宣传的益处，与患者信中描述的症状作了比较。

entries.en: A crack near the anticathode was visible in the enlarged photograph of the old tube.
entries.zh: 那张旧管的放大照片中，可以看到对阴极附近的一条裂纹。

entries.en: The reviewer questioned the proposed anticaustic protection because the damaged surfaces had not been examined.
entries.zh: 审阅者质疑所提出的抗腐蚀保护作用，因为受损表面尚未经过检查。

entries.en: The physician separated the manufacturer's anticephalalgic claim from the patient's own account of relief.
entries.zh: 医生把厂商的抗头痛宣称，与患者本人对症状缓解的叙述区分开来。

entries.en: The paper compared water samples collected before and after antichloration.
entries.zh: 论文比较了脱氯前后采集的水样。

entries.meaningZh: 抗萎黄病的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The old antichlorotic preparations were discussed separately from the patients' recorded diets.
entries.zh: 那些旧的抗萎黄病制剂，与记录中的患者饮食被分别讨论。

entries.en: The archive held an anticholera campaign poster with its date partly obscured by water damage.
entries.zh: 档案中保存着一张抗霍乱运动海报，其日期有一部分因水渍而难以辨认。

entries.meaningZh: 抗舞蹈狂的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historian questioned the claimed antichoromanic treatment after comparing two conflicting descriptions of the episode.
entries.zh: 历史学家比较了对那次事件的两种矛盾描述后，质疑所声称的抗舞蹈狂治疗。

entries.en: The chart compared antichymosin activity in the original serum and the separated fraction.
entries.zh: 图表比较了原血清与分离组分中的抗凝乳酶活性。

entries.en: The antichymotrypsin measurements could not be pooled because the laboratories had reported different units.
entries.zh: 由于各实验室报告的单位不同，那些抗凝乳蛋白酶测量数据无法合并。

entries.meaningZh: 抗凝血素〔旧免疫学用语〕
entries.en: The historical analysis distinguished anticoagulin from the coagulin against which it reacted.
entries.zh: 那次历史分析把抗凝血素与其所作用的凝血素区分开来。

entries.en: Their anticolibacillary findings concerned one bacterial strain, not every strain considered in the review.
entries.zh: 他们的抗大肠杆菌研究结果涉及一个菌株，而不是综述所考虑的所有菌株。

entries.en: The proposed anticollagenase activity remained uncertain because collagen breakdown had not been measured.
entries.zh: 由于胶原降解尚未被测量，所提出的抗胶原酶活性仍不能确定。

entries.en: She checked the sign of the anticommutator before simplifying the operator expression.
entries.zh: 她在化简算符表达式之前，核查了反对易式的符号。

entries.en: The scientist compared anticomplement in the two serum fractions rather than relying on the original mixture alone.
entries.zh: 科学家比较了两份血清组分中的抗补体，而不是仅凭原来的混合物作判断。

entries.en: The apparent anticomplementary effect disappeared when the results were compared with the previously missing control data.
entries.zh: 把结果与先前缺失的对照数据作比较后，表面上的抗补体效果便不成立了。

entries.en: The analyst questioned the anticonalbumin result because the comparison sample had been mislabelled.
entries.zh: 由于对照样品标签贴错，分析人员质疑了抗伴白蛋白的检测结果。

entries.en: The museum kept the old anticonceptive in its original packaging rather than displaying the contents separately.
entries.zh: 博物馆把那种旧避孕剂保留在原包装中，没有将内容物单独展出。

entries.en: An old catalogue listed an anticoncipiens whose ingredients were not disclosed to purchasers.
entries.zh: 一本旧目录列出了一种没有向购买者公开成分的避孕剂。

entries.en: The historian examined the city's anticontagious rules alongside complaints about crowded lodging houses.
entries.zh: 历史学家把该市防止接触传染的规定，与有关拥挤旅舍的投诉一并研究。

entries.en: The review distinguished an anticonvulsive claim from evidence that the recorded episodes had actually become less frequent.
entries.zh: 综述把抗惊厥宣称，与所记录发作确实变得较少的证据区分开来。

entries.en: The stable record noted an anticor beneath the horse's harness and included a drawing of its position.
entries.zh: 马厩记录记载了马挽具下面的一处轭疮，并附有标示其位置的图画。

entries.en: The bridge budget set aside funds for anticorrosion as well as repairs to the broken railing.
entries.zh: 桥梁预算除了安排破损栏杆的维修费用，还为防腐蚀留出了资金。

entries.en: Our photographs of Anticosti were blurred, but the handwritten notes from the trip remained clear.
entries.zh: 我们拍的安蒂科斯蒂岛照片模糊了，但旅行时手写的笔记仍然清楚。

entries.en: The old analysis of anticreatinine was difficult to assess because its original laboratory records were missing.
entries.zh: 由于原始实验记录缺失，那份有关抗肌酸酐的旧分析难以评估。

entries.en: The historical report claimed an anticritical benefit but did not record how often the crises had occurred beforehand.
entries.zh: 那份历史报告声称具有防猝变的益处，却没有记录此前危象发生的频率。

entries.en: The report considered anticrotin separately from the toxin used in the comparison.
entries.zh: 报告把抗巴豆毒素与比较中采用的毒素分开讨论。

entries.en: The engineer questioned whether the anticrustator had made any difference to deposits inside the old boiler.
entries.zh: 工程师质疑那种防垢剂是否对旧锅炉内部的沉积物产生过影响。

entries.en: The pharmacist's old notes mentioned an anticteric remedy without claiming that it addressed every cause of jaundice.
entries.zh: 药剂师的旧笔记提到一种抗黄疸药，但没有声称它能处理黄疸的所有病因。

entries.meaningZh: 中和结核菌素皮肤反应的抗体〔旧用语〕
entries.en: The old discussion of anticutin would have been clearer if the control observations had been preserved.
entries.zh: 如果对照观察记录得到保存，那篇关于中和结核菌素皮肤反应抗体的旧论述本会更清楚。

entries.en: The analyst compared anticytolysin activity with the extent of cell damage recorded in the same experiment.
entries.zh: 分析人员把抗溶细胞素活性，与同一实验中记录的细胞损伤程度作了比较。

entries.en: The historical paper questioned whether anticytotoxin alone explained the difference between the two serum samples.
entries.zh: 那篇历史论文质疑，仅凭抗细胞毒素是否足以解释两份血清样品之间的差异。

entries.en: He brought the antidepressive packaging to his appointment because the name on his written list was incomplete.
entries.zh: 他去赴约时带上了抗抑郁剂的包装，因为手写清单上的药名不完整。

entries.en: The laboratory could not compare the antidesoxyribonuclease results until the two reporting methods were identified.
entries.zh: 在明确两种报告方法之前，实验室无法比较那些抗去氧核糖核酸酶检测结果。

entries.en: The reviewer asked whether the proposed antidiabetogenic effect concerned disease development rather than a temporary change in blood glucose measurements.
entries.zh: 审稿人询问，所提出的抗糖尿病发生效果涉及的是疾病发生，还是血糖测量值的暂时变化。

entries.en: The old stock list included an antidiarrheic whose packet had lost its manufacturer's name.
entries.zh: 那份旧库存清单中有一种止泻剂，其包装上的厂商名称已经脱落。

entries.en: The historical report compared antidiastase in separate serum fractions without establishing the identity of every component.
entries.zh: 那份历史报告比较了不同血清组分中的抗淀粉水解酶，却没有确定每一种成分的身份。

entries.en: The chemist wanted a clearer spectrum before accepting the proposed antidiazosulphonate structure.
entries.zh: 化学家要求先提供更清楚的谱图，再接受所提出的反重氮磺酸盐结构。

entries.meaningZh: 抑制消化的；妨碍消化的
entries.en: The review questioned an antidigestive effect that had been inferred from appetite changes alone.
entries.zh: 综述质疑了仅凭食欲变化推断出的抑制消化作用。

entries.en: The old advertisement promised antidinic relief without distinguishing dizziness from other complaints.
entries.zh: 那则旧广告承诺具有缓解眩晕的效果，却没有把眩晕与其他不适区分开来。

entries.en: The historical collection contained an antidiphtherin container alongside the supplier's original invoice.
entries.zh: 那批历史藏品中有一个抗白喉菌素容器，旁边是供应商的原始发票。

entries.en: The hospital's old ledger recorded an antidiphtheritic delivery but gave no details about the preparation.
entries.zh: 医院的旧账簿记录了一批抗白喉剂的送达情况，却没有说明制剂的细节。

entries.en: The old catalogue listed an antidipticum separately from remedies advertised for dry coughs.
entries.zh: 那本旧目录把一种止渴剂与宣传用于干咳的药物分开列出。

entries.en: The study discussed antidiuresis separately from changes in the colour of the collected urine.
entries.zh: 那项研究把抑制尿分泌，与所收集尿液颜色的变化分开讨论。

entries.en: The curator compared the Antidorcas skulls with the older drawings before rearranging the display.
entries.zh: 策展人在重新布置展览前，把跳羚属头骨与较旧的图画作了比较。

entries.en: The historian compared the advertised antidotic properties with the evidence actually recorded in the case notes.
entries.zh: 历史学家把广告所宣称的解毒性质，与病例笔记中实际记录的证据作了比较。

entries.en: The report distinguished the proposed antidynamic effect from the patient's separately reported sleepiness.
entries.zh: 报告把所提出的减力作用，与患者另行报告的困倦区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 抗恶液质的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The old antidyscratic claim was difficult to judge because the patient's earlier condition had not been described.
entries.zh: 由于没有描述患者此前的状况，那项旧的抗恶液质宣称难以判断。

entries.en: The museum preserved an antidysentericum packet without presenting its printed claims as modern treatment advice.
entries.zh: 博物馆保存了一包抗痢剂，但没有把包装上的宣传当作现代治疗建议。

entries.en: The review considered an antiedematous effect separately from the reported change in pain.
entries.zh: 综述把抗水肿作用与所报告的疼痛变化分开考虑。

entries.en: The lecturer distinguished an antielement from an ordinary element with a different number of neutrons.
entries.zh: 讲师把反元素与中子数不同的普通元素区分开来。

entries.en: The historical investigation compared antiemulsin in two fractions before discussing their different effects on the enzyme.
entries.zh: 那项历史研究先比较了两份组分中的抗苦杏仁酶，再讨论它们对该酶不同的影响。

entries.en: The apparent antiendotoxic activity was reported only for the tested material, not every product in the series.
entries.zh: 所报告的表观抗内毒素活性仅涉及受测材料，而不是该系列的每一种产品。

entries.en: The analyst asked whether the measured antiendotoxin was present before the samples were mixed.
entries.zh: 分析人员询问，测得的抗内毒素在样品混合之前是否就已存在。

entries.en: The old account described an antienergic action opposing the response observed in the comparison.
entries.zh: 那篇旧记述描述了一种反作用，与比较中观察到的反应相对抗。

entries.en: The histologist compared the reported antiepithelial effect with the damage visible in the tissue images.
entries.zh: 组织学家把所报告的抗上皮作用，与组织图像中可见的损伤作了比较。

entries.en: The historian examined advertisements for antierotica alongside private letters questioning their supposed benefits.
entries.zh: 历史学家把制欲药广告与质疑其所谓益处的私人信件一并研究。

entries.en: The pharmacist found an antierrhine on the old stock list but no record of its ingredients.
entries.zh: 药剂师在旧库存清单中发现一种止涕药，却没有找到其成分记录。

entries.en: The paper separated antiesterase measurements from the measurements of the enzyme itself.
entries.zh: 论文把抗酯酶的测量数据，与该酶本身的测量数据区分开来。

entries.meaningZh: 退热冰；乙酰苯胺〔旧商品名〕
entries.en: The historian traced an antifebrin order through three letters exchanged between the pharmacy and its supplier.
entries.zh: 历史学家通过药房与供应商往来的三封信，追查了一张退热冰订单。

entries.en: The fictional Antifederalist argued that distant officials would ignore the concerns of small communities.
entries.zh: 那位虚构的反联邦主义者认为，远方的官员会忽视小社区的关切。

entries.en: The entomologist counted the untouched leaves before assessing the antifeedant's effect.
entries.zh: 昆虫学家在评估拒食素的作用前，清点了那些没有被取食的叶片。

entries.en: The old analysis distinguished the proposed antiferment from the enzyme whose activity it was thought to inhibit.
entries.zh: 那次旧分析把所提出的抗酶，与被认为受其抑制的酶区分开来。

entries.en: The physics class compared antiferromagnets with the strongly magnetised bar on the desk.
entries.zh: 物理课上，学生们把反铁磁体与桌上那根被强烈磁化的棒作了比较。

entries.en: The researcher compared antifibrinolysin measurements with the recorded rate of clot breakdown.
entries.zh: 研究人员把抗血纤维蛋白溶酶的测量数据，与记录的凝块分解速度作了比较。

entries.en: The study of antifibrinolysis examined how long the clots persisted rather than counting newly formed clots.
entries.zh: 那项抗纤维蛋白溶解研究考察了凝块持续多久，而不是清点新形成的凝块。

entries.en: The proposed antifibromatogenic benefit could not be assessed from photographs of a single lesion alone.
entries.zh: 仅凭单个病灶的照片，无法评估所提出的抗纤维瘤益处。

entries.en: The supply record named an antifilarial but did not identify the manufacturer of the delivered packets.
entries.zh: 供货记录列出一种抗丝虫药，却没有说明送达药包的生产商。

entries.en: Foam returned after the antifoamer ran out during the demonstration.
entries.zh: 演示过程中消泡剂用完后，泡沫又出现了。

entries.en: The photographer compared negatives made with and without the antifoggant.
entries.zh: 摄影师比较了使用与未使用防翳剂制作的底片。

entries.en: The reviewer asked for evidence of antifolic action rather than accepting a change in cell numbers as sufficient proof.
entries.zh: 审稿人要求提供抗叶酸作用的证据，而没有把细胞数量变化当作充分证明。

entries.en: The museum's antiformin bottle retained its original stopper, but most of the printed label had faded.
entries.zh: 博物馆的安替佛民瓶还保留着原来的瓶塞，但印刷标签大部分已经褪色。

entries.en: The mechanic checked the antifreezer invoice after noticing that the delivered containers differed from the order.
entries.zh: 机械师注意到送来的容器与订单不一致后，核查了防冻剂发票。

entries.en: The engineer compared the persistent foam with the amount of antifrother recorded in the production log.
entries.zh: 工程师把持续存在的泡沫，与生产日志中记录的消泡剂用量作了比较。

entries.en: The analyst could not compare antigelatinase activity because one set of results lacked a stated measurement method.
entries.zh: 由于一组结果没有说明测量方法，分析人员无法比较抗明胶酶活性。

entries.en: The altered protein's antigenicity was considered separately from whether it retained its original function.
entries.zh: 对于改变后的蛋白质，其抗原性与它是否保留原有功能被分别考虑。

entries.meaningZh: 嗜抗原的〔旧免疫学用语〕
entries.en: The old diagram marked an antigenophil region without explaining how its affinity had been tested.
entries.zh: 那幅旧图标出一个嗜抗原区域，却没有解释其亲和性如何被检测。

entries.en: The historical review of antigenotherapy separated proposed explanations from the outcomes actually recorded.
entries.zh: 那篇抗原疗法历史综述，把所提出的解释与实际记录的结果区分开来。

entries.en: The plant study compared growth measurements before discussing whether an antigibberellin was responsible for the difference.
entries.zh: 那项植物研究先比较了生长测量数据，再讨论差异是否由一种抗赤霉素引起。

entries.en: The laboratory repeated the antiglobulin test because the original record omitted the control result.
entries.zh: 由于原始记录遗漏了对照结果，实验室重复了抗球蛋白试验。

entries.en: The antiglyoxalase result remained uncertain because the comparison measurements had been taken on a different scale.
entries.zh: 由于对照测量采用了不同标度，抗乙二醛酶的检测结果仍不能确定。

entries.en: The reviewer questioned the proposed antigoitrogenic effect because the study had not tracked thyroid enlargement over time.
entries.zh: 审稿人质疑所提出的抗甲状腺肿发生作用，因为研究没有随时间追踪甲状腺增大情况。

entries.en: The review distinguished antigonadotrophic activity from a general reduction in the animals' growth.
entries.zh: 综述把抗促性腺激素活性，与动物生长的普遍减缓区分开来。

entries.en: The curator compared the Antigonia specimens with drawings from an older fish catalogue.
entries.zh: 策展人把菱鲷属标本与一本较旧鱼类目录中的图画作了比较。

entries.en: The historian examined an antigonorrheic advertisement without treating its claims as evidence of effectiveness.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了一则抗淋病广告，但没有把其中的宣传当作有效性的证据。

entries.en: The geologist photographed the antigorite where the mineral band crossed the darker rock.
entries.zh: 地质学家在矿物带穿过较暗岩石的位置拍下了叶蛇纹石。

entries.en: The analyst compared antihaemoagglutinin measurements from two samples whose collection dates were clearly documented.
entries.zh: 分析人员比较了两份采集日期记录清楚的样品中的抗血凝集素测量数据。

entries.en: The old report considered antihaemolysin separately from the haemolysin present in the comparison sample.
entries.zh: 那份旧报告把抗溶血素与对照样品中的溶血素分开考虑。

entries.en: The artist redrew the antihelix after comparing the portrait with a close photograph of the ear.
entries.zh: 画家把肖像与耳部特写照片作比较后，重新画了对耳轮。

entries.en: The report did not establish whether antihemoagglutinin was present in the sample before it was stored.
entries.zh: 报告没有确定，样品在储存之前是否就已含有抗血凝集素。

entries.en: The historical experiment compared antihemolysin activity with the amount of red-cell damage visible in the photographs.
entries.zh: 那次历史实验把抗溶血素活性，与照片中可见的红细胞损伤程度作了比较。

entries.en: The study considered antihemolysis separately from an increase in the total number of red cells.
entries.zh: 那项研究把抗溶血作用，与红细胞总数增加分开考虑。

entries.en: The apparent antihemolytic effect was questioned after the damaged-cell counts were checked again.
entries.zh: 重新核查受损细胞计数后，表观抗溶血效果受到了质疑。

entries.en: The review asked whether the claimed antihemorrhagic benefit concerned fewer bleeding episodes or shorter episodes.
entries.zh: 综述询问，所声称的抗出血益处指的是出血发作次数减少，还是每次持续时间缩短。

entries.en: The archive contained an advertisement for an antihemorrhoidal preparation, with the manufacturer's address cut away.
entries.zh: 档案中有一则治痔药广告，其厂商地址部分已被剪去。

entries.en: The analyst compared the antiheparin result with the original trace rather than relying on a copied table.
entries.zh: 分析人员把抗肝素的检测结果与原始谱线作比较，而不是依靠抄录的表格。

entries.en: The authors questioned an antiherpetic claim that rested on photographs without dates or comparison cases.
entries.zh: 作者们质疑了一项治疱疹宣称，因为它所依据的照片没有日期，也没有对照病例。

entries.en: The old investigation distinguished antiheterolysin from the serum components that had not yet been identified.
entries.zh: 那项旧研究把抗异种溶素与尚未鉴定的血清成分区分开来。

entries.en: The pharmacist checked the antihistaminic's name against the original prescription because the copied list was unclear.
entries.zh: 由于抄录的清单不清楚，药剂师对照原处方核查了抗组胺剂的名称。

entries.en: The historical paper proposed an antihormone but did not establish its molecular identity.
entries.zh: 那篇历史论文提出存在一种抗激素，却没有确定其分子身份。

entries.en: The laboratory kept the antihyaluronidase results separate from measurements of the enzyme's abundance.
entries.zh: 实验室把抗透明质酸酶的检测结果，与该酶丰度的测量数据分开保存。

entries.meaningZh: 抗狂犬病的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The historian examined an antihydrophobic campaign poster without confusing its subject with water-repellent materials.
entries.zh: 历史学家研究了一张抗狂犬病运动海报，没有把它的主题与防水材料混淆。

entries.en: The patient's letter questioned whether the antihydropic had changed the swelling at all.
entries.zh: 患者在信中质疑，那种抗水肿药究竟是否改变了肿胀情况。

entries.en: The old antihydropin invoice was filed with the supplier's unanswered letter about a missing shipment.
entries.zh: 那张蟑螂利尿素旧发票，与供应商那封涉及货物下落不明、但未得到回复的信一起归档。

entries.en: Sharing a single dirty towel struck her as both inconvenient and antihygienic.
entries.zh: 她觉得共用一条脏毛巾既不方便，也不卫生。

entries.en: The report named an antihyperlipoproteinemic but omitted the manufacturer's identification of the product.
entries.zh: 报告列出一种抗高脂蛋白血症药，却遗漏了厂商对该产品的标识信息。

entries.en: The historian compared advertisements for an antihysteric with the experiences described in women's private diaries.
entries.zh: 历史学家把一种抗癔病药的广告，与女性私人日记中描述的经历作了比较。

entries.en: The copied record misspelled the antiinflammatory's name, so the pharmacist checked the original prescription.
entries.zh: 抄录的记录把抗炎药的名称拼错了，因此药剂师核查了原处方。

entries.en: The researcher asked whether antiinsulinase was already present in the serum before the experiment began.
entries.zh: 研究人员询问，实验开始之前，血清中是否就已经存在抗胰岛素酶。

entries.meaningZh: 安替坎尼亚〔旧退热止痛成药名〕
entries.en: The museum's Antikamnia packet was displayed beside a letter questioning the manufacturer's advertising.
entries.zh: 博物馆那包安替坎尼亚旁边，展出着一封质疑厂商广告的信。

entries.en: The engineer compared the damaged antikathode with the original drawing of the tube.
entries.zh: 工程师把受损的对阴极，与管的原始图纸作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 抗疲倦毒素〔旧假说中的物质〕
entries.en: The historical paper proposed antikenotoxin but supplied no conclusive evidence identifying the substance.
entries.zh: 那篇历史论文提出存在抗疲倦毒素，却没有提供确定该物质身份的确凿证据。

entries.en: The student distinguished an antiketogen from a ketone in the pathway diagram.
entries.zh: 学生在通路图中，把一种抗生酮物质与一种酮区分开来。

entries.en: The discussion of antiketogenesis concerned reduced ketone formation rather than removal of ketones after they had formed.
entries.zh: 关于抗生酮作用的讨论，涉及酮形成的减少，而不是形成之后再将其清除。

entries.en: The proposed antiketogenetic effect required evidence about production, not just a change in the final measurement.
entries.zh: 所提出的抗生酮作用需要有关生成过程的证据，而不仅是最终测量值的变化。

entries.en: The claimed antiketogenic benefit was not established by a single ketone measurement.
entries.zh: 仅凭一次酮测量，尚不能证实所声称的抗生酮益处。

entries.en: The analyst compared antikinase activity with the results for the enzyme it was thought to oppose.
entries.zh: 分析人员把抗激酶活性，与被认为受其对抗的酶的检测结果作了比较。

entries.meaningZh: 中和结核菌素皮肤反应的抗体〔旧用语〕
entries.en: The old antikutin report lacked the control observations needed to assess its interpretation of the skin reaction.
entries.zh: 那份关于中和结核菌素皮肤反应抗体的旧报告，缺少评估其皮肤反应解释所需的对照观察。

entries.en: The historical account separated antilab measurements from observations of the clotting produced by the enzyme.
entries.zh: 那份历史记述把抗凝乳酶的测量数据，与该酶所致凝结的观察结果区分开来。

entries.en: The antilaccase result was excluded because the report gave no way to identify the comparison material.
entries.zh: 由于报告没有提供鉴定对照材料的办法，抗漆酶的检测结果被排除了。

entries.en: The old analysis compared antilactase with the lactase preparation used in the same investigation.
entries.zh: 那次旧分析把抗乳糖酶与同项研究采用的乳糖酶制剂作了比较。

entries.en: The report distinguished antilactoserum from the original milk serum used for comparison.
entries.zh: 报告把抗乳血清与用于比较的原乳血清区分开来。

entries.en: The archive's antilemic notices were dated, but the accompanying lists of affected households were not.
entries.zh: 档案中的抗鼠疫告示标有日期，但随附的受影响住户名单没有日期。

entries.en: The old antileprol container still had its purchase date written on the underside.
entries.zh: 那个旧抗麻风油容器的底部，仍写着购买日期。

entries.en: The newly catalogued packet contained an antileprotic, but its accompanying information sheet had been lost.
entries.zh: 新编目的一包藏品中装着抗麻风药，但随附的说明页已经遗失。

entries.en: The old antilethargic advertisement confused feeling more alert with evidence that the underlying illness had improved.
entries.zh: 那则旧的防嗜眠广告，把感觉更清醒与原有疾病已经好转的证据混淆了。

entries.en: The investigator compared antileukocidin activity with the recorded damage to white blood cells.
entries.zh: 研究者把抗杀白细胞素活性，与记录的白细胞损伤作了比较。

entries.en: The laboratory kept the antileukoprotease results apart from measurements of total protein in the samples.
entries.zh: 实验室把抗白细胞蛋白酶的检测结果，与样品总蛋白的测量数据分开保存。

entries.en: The historical paper considered antileukotoxin without establishing which serum component accounted for the observed difference.
entries.zh: 那篇历史论文讨论了抗白细胞毒素，却没有确定观察到的差异由哪一种血清成分造成。

entries.en: The proposed antilipoid was examined separately from the lipids recovered in the same fraction.
entries.zh: 所提出的抗类脂物质，与同一组分中分离出的类脂被分别检查。

entries.meaningZh: 防治尿酸血症的〔旧医学用语〕
entries.en: The reviewer questioned the antilithemic claim because the account included no measurements of uric acid in blood.
entries.zh: 审阅者质疑那项防治尿酸血症宣称，因为记述中没有血液尿酸的测量数据。

entries.en: The historian distinguished an antilithic advertised for prevention from another preparation claiming to dissolve existing stones.
entries.zh: 历史学家把一种宣传用于预防的防结石剂，与另一种声称能溶解已有结石的制剂区分开来。

entries.en: The zoologist compared the Antilocapra skull with photographs from the older mammal collection.
entries.zh: 动物学家把叉角羚属头骨，与较旧哺乳动物藏品的照片作了比较。

entries.en: The fossil cabinet included Antilocapridae specimens whose collection sites were carefully recorded.
entries.zh: 化石柜中有一些叉角羚科标本，其采集地点都有详细记录。

entries.en: The historian read the antiloemic campaign's posters alongside letters describing the crowded streets.
entries.zh: 历史学家把抗鼠疫运动海报，与描述街道拥挤情况的信件一并阅读。

entries.en: The physician noted antilogia when two findings seemed incompatible with the same explanation.
entries.zh: 两项检查结果似乎无法用同一种解释说明时，医生记下了症象矛盾。

entries.en: The curator compared the Antilopinae illustrations with photographs of the preserved specimens.
entries.zh: 策展人把羚羊亚科插图，与保存标本的照片作了比较。

entries.en: The historical review examined antiluetic claims against the evidence preserved in the original case records.
entries.zh: 那篇历史综述对照原始病例记录中保存的证据，考察了抗梅毒宣称。

entries.en: The proposed antiluteogenic effect concerned formation of the corpus luteum, not merely a change in its appearance.
entries.zh: 所提出的抗黄体发生作用，涉及黄体的形成，而不只是其外观变化。

entries.en: The scientist compared antilysin with the lysin whose action it was thought to counteract.
entries.zh: 科学家比较了抗溶素与一种溶素；前者被认为能对抗后者的作用。

entries.meaningZh: 抗溶素作用〔阻止细胞溶解〕
entries.en: The historical account discussed antilysis separately from the formation of new cells.
entries.zh: 那份历史记述把阻止细胞溶解的抗溶素作用，与新细胞的形成分开讨论。

entries.en: The local archive kept an antilyssic notice with the council's correspondence about stray dogs.
entries.zh: 地方档案把一张抗狂犬病告示，与市议会讨论流浪狗的往来信件一起保存。

entries.meaningZh: 抗溶素作用的〔抗细胞溶解的〕
entries.en: The proposed antilytic effect concerned preservation of existing cells rather than an increase in cell production.
entries.zh: 所提出的抗细胞溶解作用，涉及已有细胞的保存，而不是细胞生成的增加。

entries.en: The reviewer considered the antimaniacal claim separately from a general reduction in the patient's activity.
entries.zh: 审阅者把抗躁狂宣称，与患者活动的普遍减少分开考虑。

entries.en: The old analysis of antimannase could not be repeated because the original comparison material was no longer available.
entries.zh: 由于原来的对照材料已无法获得，那次抗甘露聚糖酶旧分析无法重做。

entries.en: The narrator praises an antimedical remedy, while the novel's physician repeatedly questions its supposed benefits.
entries.zh: 叙述者赞扬一种违反医理的疗法，而小说中的医生反复质疑其所谓益处。

entries.en: The historian compared an antimelancholic advertisement with the experiences described in the patient's own letters.
entries.zh: 历史学家把一种抗忧郁药的广告，与患者本人信中描述的经历作了比较。

entries.en: The report distinguished an antimeningococcic effect from activity directed against a different bacterium.
entries.zh: 报告把抗脑膜炎球菌作用，与针对另一种细菌的活性区分开来。

entries.en: The old advertisement promised an antimephitic effect without establishing what had caused the unpleasant smell.
entries.zh: 那则旧广告承诺具有抗臭效果，却没有确定难闻气味由什么造成。

entries.meaningZh: 对映体；光学异构对映体
entries.en: The measured rotation was opposite to that of its antimer under the same conditions.
entries.zh: 在相同条件下，测得的旋光方向与其对映体相反。
